title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

source_manifest.title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
source_manifest.finding: Independent fairseq reimplementation reproduces BERT-level results; controlled training experiments retain effective MLM, but removing next-sentence prediction matches or improves performance.

source_manifest.title: BioBERT: a pre-trained biomedical language representation model for biomedical text mining
source_manifest.finding: Korea University researchers reuse original BERT initialization and architecture for biomedical corpora; improved biomedical extraction and QA support domain transfer.

source_manifest.title: Right for the Wrong Reasons: Diagnosing Syntactic Heuristics in Natural Language Inference
source_manifest.finding: Independent HANS tests show BERT performs poorly on cases invalidating lexical-overlap, subsequence and constituent heuristics.

source_manifest.title: On the Stability of Fine-tuning BERT: Misconceptions, Explanations, and Strong Baselines
source_manifest.finding: Independent experiments reproduce instability on small GLUE datasets and improve performance with a revised optimization schedule; original-recipe results remain variable.

source_manifest.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Pretrained Foundation Models: A History from BERT to ChatGPT
source_manifest.finding: Independent synthesis treats BERT as foundational for contextual pretrained representations and subsequent masking, domain-adaptation and multimodal research, while discussing limitations.

source_manifest.title: Understanding searches better than ever before
source_manifest.finding: Google documents BERT deployment in search ranking and featured snippets.

source_manifest.title: Selecting Between BERT and GPT for Text Classification in Political Science Research
source_manifest.finding: Comparisons actually use RoBERTa-large, a BERT descendant, against GPT-4o prompting. Supervised classification remains useful; relative performance varies with labels and task.

search_gaps: Original v1 full text read; challenge cohort is not a representative training sample.
Two unknowns concern literal survival of stated limitations and independent isolation of original comparative advantage.
2024 comparison uses RoBERTa-large, not the unchanged BERT checkpoint; adoption is documented by Google itself.
Lifetime evidence searched through 2026-09-16; latest selected primary comparison is 2024, not a census of subsequent uses.
research.summary: Independent reproduction, biomedical transfer, operational deployment and later synthesis establish durable uptake. HANS exposes syntactic shortcuts, RoBERTa challenges NSP necessity, and instability requires care. Original limitation-survival and isolated advantage questions remain unresolved.
